## Rulings requested

1. One model has stayed at 91 percent of triggered prompts for three epochs. Should I stop training it and record it as unplanted? I judged this a plan-tier question. Stopping frees its GPU for the 20 other models still to finish, and loses the chance that more epochs plant it; training on keeps that chance, and costs up to 22 more epochs of one GPU. I recommend training on, because the sweep's own stop condition is the 25-epoch ceiling. If you do not answer, the next step at 14:40 today keeps training it and changes nothing else.
